android.desc:
Are you ready for your next strategic challenge?

RE4M is not just another "4 in a row" game. It is a deep tactical battle where every move counts. The goal is simple: get 4 pieces in a row. The path to victory? More complex than ever.

What makes RE4M unique?

⭐ Star Mode: Stuck? Use a star to "push" an opponent's piece, take over their spot, and shift the game's momentum! But be careful - you only have two stars per match.

🏝️ Islands & Obstacles: The board is never empty. Place "islands" to block areas, choose from various presets (like Cross, Corners, or Random), or face a new challenge every time.

🛠️ Layout Editor: Have an idea for a crazy board? Use the built-in editor to design your own island layouts, save them, and play on them against friends.

🏆 Play Anywhere, Against Anyone:

Online Multiplayer: Challenge friends or compete against players worldwide in ranked matches. Climb the leaderboard and prove you're the best.

Local Play: Go head-to-head with a friend on the same device.

Additional Features:

Clean and elegant design.

Personal profile with stats and Elo rating tracking.

Full support for English and Hebrew.

Download RE4M now and see if you have what it takes to win!

quotes.text:
RE4M, an abstract strategy game inspired by Connect 4 and Chess mechanics. The core concept is simple: get 4 in a row. But there's a catch - you have limited resources to physically push your opponent's pieces, changing the board layout instantly.
It’s completely free.
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.re4m.game&pcampaignid=web_share

Web (No install needed): https://playre4m.com/
